groups.meta: unlocks Thermia Fractures in the World State Window

rows.label: Thermia Fracture points
rows.note: 1 per canister contributed, plus 3 when a Diluted Thermia canister fills

conditions: Thermia Fractures only run while the event is active; check the World State Window.
Points carry over permanently between event windows, so partial progress is never lost.
Recruit through LFG or a clanmate rather than public matchmaking; public squads scatter before a fracture is sealed.
bonuses: Stage up to 4 canisters at a Blink Pad near the fracture before committing them all at once.
Amesha with Benevolent Decoy stacked three times can solo-defend a canister from the air; stay at max altitude to avoid ground-to-air rockets.
Filling the leftover Diluted Thermia summons the Exploiter Orb for Hildryn parts, and 35%+ event control doubles Orb Vallis credit rewards.

disclosures.title: reward track
disclosures.body: 5 points: emblem. 25: Amalgam Shotgun Barrage + Amalgam Serration. 50: Amalgam Barrel Diffusion + Amalgam Organ Shatter. 75: sigil. 100: Opticor Vandal with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Each tier is a one-time reward with no replacement source once claimed.
